However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. 2. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 3. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) To ensure the comprehensive upkeep and aesthetic maintenance of the NICS campus with garden spannin g a total area of 4 acres (approximately 16,187 sq. meters), two (02) Malis are required. The deploy ed personnel shall be responsible for the day-to-day horticultural operations across the entire 4-acre premi ses, including regular watering of lawns, trees, shrubs, and potted plants; periodic mowing, weeding, and t op-dressing of grass; hoeing of flower beds; trimming and shaping of hedges and edges; and propagation of seasonal plants. Additionally, the hired manpower must carry out seasonal soil preparation, application of organic manure, fertilizers, and pesticides/insecticides as directed by the Officer-in-Charge, as well as the timely replaceme nt of plant casualties. The Malis will also be responsible for maintaining garden cleanliness by clearing dry leaves, twigs, and gar den waste, managing compost pits, and operating basic gardening tools and irrigation equipment safely. The Malis deployed by the service provider must be physically fit, possess prior practical experience in inst itutional or commercial landscaping, and strictly adhere to the prescribed working hours, statutory minimu m wage norms, and discipline guidelines of the department. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific SLA Text Clause(s) Prospective bidders are strongly advised to attend Pre Bid Meeting to discuss GeM Bid Document and clarify issues, answer questions on matter that may be raised regarding the Scope of Work, Technical Spe cifications, or Commercial Terms and Conditions Not more than two (02) authorized representatives per bidding firm shall be permitted to attend the confe rence. Representatives attending the meeting must carry a valid Letter of Authorization on the company’s official letterhead signed by the competent signatory, along with a valid government-issued photo ID.
